la-aroma-de-cuba-ni--la-aroma-de-cuba-cl.description: Ashton revived the old Cuban name La Aroma de Cuba in 2002 and has had it made in Nicaragua by the García family since 2008. The classic blend sets a Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper over Nicaraguan binder and filler. It smokes rich and creamy, moving from cream and sweet chocolate to cedar and wood and on to dark coffee, with white pepper and cocoa in the aroma.

thirds.notes: Thick smoke with cream and sweet chocolate in front, and an easy draw.
The chocolate gives way to a cedar-led, woody character.
Dark coffee comes forward while the creaminess lasts to the end.

la-aroma-de-cuba-ni--la-aroma-de-cuba-co.description: A milder La Aroma de Cuba rolled by My Father Cigars in Estelí, the Connecticut uses an Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper over triple-fermented Nicaraguan binder and filler grown by the García family, rolled entubado and finished with a Cuban-style triple cap. Mild to medium, it offers coffee, cedar and almond. Outside the United States it is sold as La Aroma del Caribe.

la-aroma-de-cuba-ni--la-aroma-de-cuba-ed.description: Introduced in 2008, when La Aroma de Cuba moved to the García family's My Father factory in Estelí, the Edición Especial pairs an Ecuadorian Habano wrapper with Nicaraguan binder and filler. Ashton reworked it in 2020 to give it more strength. Black pepper leads, with cocoa, cream and coffee behind it, and the cigar gains strength steadily as it burns.

thirds.notes: A slow start dominated by black pepper; cocoa, cream and coffee surface later in the third.
Cocoa, almond, caramel-like sweetness and cedar appear briefly, with pepper, hay and cream on the finish.
Few new flavours, but the nicotine rises clearly toward the end.

la-aroma-de-cuba-ni--la-aroma-de-cuba-mi.description: La Aroma de Cuba Mi Amor, made at My Father Cigars in Estelí, wraps a Nicaraguan binder and aged García-estate filler in an oily, box-pressed Mexican San Andrés maduro leaf. Medium-full and creamy, it opens on cocoa and pepper, grows sweeter with coffee and caramel through the middle, and closes dense and rich on cocoa, earth and cedar.

thirds.notes: Cocoa and a firm pepper kick lead, with cedar and a creamy texture.
The pepper softens as cream, espresso-like coffee and caramel sweetness build around the cocoa, with earthy balance.
Dense and rich: cocoa and earth lead, with cedar and roasted nuts, as the body reaches its fullest.

la-aroma-de-cuba-ni--la-aroma-de-cuba-no.description: Noblesse was La Aroma de Cuba's first limited edition, shown in 2014 and capped at 3,000 boxes of 24, launched in a single 6½ x 52 size. Made at the García family's My Father Cigars, it uses an Ecuadorian Habano wrapper, a dual binder of Nicaraguan Habano and Criollo, and Nicaraguan filler from the family's own farms.

la-aroma-de-cuba-ni--la-aroma-de-cuba-pa.description: Launched in 2021, Pasión is an all-Nicaraguan La Aroma de Cuba blended by Pepín García and his son: a shade-grown wrapper from Namanji over binder and filler from family farms in Estelí, Jalapa and Namanji, made at My Father Cigars. Balanced and steady, it offers cedar, cashew-like nuttiness, nougat sweetness, leather and black pepper.

thirds.notes: Wood and cedar lead, with black pepper on the retrohale, smoked-cashew tones and a nougat-like sweetness.
Leather and cedar come forward; baking spice and pepper deepen as the sweetness fades.
Cedar dominates, with sharper black pepper, wood and a little earth.
